annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that an endpoint that has sent a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame respond to any packet it receives during the closing period with a packet containing a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame. The subsequent clause clarifies that the endpoint may reuse the same packet, resolving any potential confusion about whether a new packet must be sent. No missing constraints or conflicting interpretations are present.
